title: Returned Payments and the Returned Payment Fee — Ridgeline Consumer Credit
content:
When the cardholder's bank returns a payment on a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account unpaid, its amount is added back to the balance as a returned-payment line that references the payment line and records the bank's return reason. A payment that already has a returned-payment line cannot be returned again.

**Returned payment fee.** A returned payment fee of the tier's returned payment fee figure is charged, referencing the returned payment line, with two exceptions:

- **Single-event exception.** Where the tier applies the single-event rule (every tier does) and the return leaves a statement's minimum payment due unpaid as of its due date, only the late fee for that statement is charged and no returned payment fee is charged for that payment.
- **Cap exception.** Where the tier's late fee is capped at the minimum payment due, the returned payment fee may not exceed the minimum payment due of the statement the payment was made toward.

## Outcomes (hypothetical returns)

| Tier figures | Effect of the return | Minimum of the statement paid toward | Returned payment fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| fee 29.00, capped | leaves that statement's minimum unpaid at its due date | 60.00 | none (the late fee only) |
| fee 29.00, capped | the minimum stays covered by the due date | 60.00 | 29.00 |
| fee 29.00, capped | the minimum stays covered by the due date | 20.00 | 20.00 (not above the minimum) |
| fee 25.00, not capped | the minimum stays covered by the due date | 20.00 | 25.00 |

**Hypothetical second return.** A payment line already shows one returned-payment line; a second return of the same payment is not recorded.
